text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT 9421 — Degraded model outputs for tenant AuroraCorp in Dedicated pool us-west-2a. Severity: P1. Symptoms: increased token latency, partial timeouts, higher edit-distance to golden responses. Paging carlos-oncall and maya-sre.

carlos-oncall: ack. I'm on it. currently looking at routing and KV cache metrics. any customer-facing reports?

sam-solutions: tina PS got a Slack thread from Aurora support — they see ~15% hallucination rate on the primary model and spikes in 95th latency to ~2.8s (normal ~0.8s). They say impact started ~14:10 PST.

tina-ps: customer says requests started failing intermittently and some responses are truncated. They're on an active rollout, so higher QPS than usual. asking for ETA and mitigation options.

maya-sre: looking at infra: one host in us-west-2a is showing memory pressure on GPU worker 3, OOM-counter increments. Model v1.4.2 KV cache misses spiked. Bumping through logs now.

alice.platform: tagging logs from router and serving:```\n2026-03-15T21:09:12Z router: route-aurora -> pool-usw2a-1 latency 380ms\n2026-03-15T21:11:07Z serving[model:v1.4.2]: worker-3 OOM, evicting KV, respawn\n2026-03-15T21:11:09Z serving[model:v1.4.2]: ctx-12345 partial response, truncated\n2026-03-15T21:13:22Z router: fallback to safe-variant v1.3.8-quantized for some requests\n```

carlos-oncall: thanks. initial hypothesis: KV cache fragmentation after worker restarts + memory regression in v1.4.2 on our quantized path. Customer is on Dedicated reserve so we can pin/override without affecting other tenants.

sam-solutions: customer willing to accept a quick pin to a known safe variant as long as we communicate precisely. They prefer no model-change on their side.

maya-sre: propose immediate mitigation: 1) pin Aurora tenant to v1.3.8-safe (quantized non-KV path) as fallback for reads, 2) disable autoscale burst to avoid overloaded new workers, 3) trigger a graceful drain+relaunch of worker-3.

carlos-oncall: agree. We should do canary pin first for 10% of traffic for 5m, observe hallucination and latency. If stable, escalate to 100%. Also prepare revert command.

alice.platform: running canary pin now:```\n# pin 10% traffic to safe variant\n/redwood tenant pin --tenant aurora --model v1.3.8-quant-safe --percent 10 --reason "P1 mitigation: KV OOM-induced degradation"\n```

incident-bot: Command logged: tenant-pin-req-1994455667-1. User alice.platform.

alice.platform: output from control plane:```\n-> scheduling canary routing change\n-> updating policy for aurora: add fallback v1.3.8-quant-safe (10%)\n-> estimated propagation 12s\n```

lee-qa: observing test traffic spawn: sending golden prompt set against both variants to measure divergence. will post metrics in 3m.

maya-sre: monitoring metrics: 10% canary shows 95th latency 0.85s, hallucination metric drops to baseline. No new OOMs observed on target hosts.

carlos-oncall: good. proceed to 100% and then do worker drain. Keep communications line open with Tina for customer updates.

alice.platform: escalating to 100% now:```\n/redwood tenant pin --tenant aurora --model v1.3.8-quant-safe --percent 100 --reason "promote after canary stable"\n```

incident-bot: Command logged: tenant-pin-req-1994455667-2.

alice.platform: control plane: applied. routing fully switched.

maya-sre: starting drain of worker-3 and restart sequence:```\n# drain worker\n/api/infra/drain worker-3 --grace 30s\n# restart\n/api/infra/restart worker-3\n```

alice.platform: worker restart completed. kube events show pod recreated and registered. KV cache warmed gradually.

ben-security: quick note — because this is a tenant pin we must create an audit ticket and record the model hash used for compliance. I'll file it now.

ben-security: filed AUD-1994455667 with model-hash: sha256:abc123... (v1.3.8-quant-safe).

carlos-oncall: next steps: 1) monitor for 30m, 2) run a deeper diff on samples from the customer's failing set to ensure semantic integrity, 3) coordinate post-mortem and customer-facing summary.

tina-ps: I'll let Aurora know we've applied a targeted pin to a safe variant and actions taken; they'll want a short RCA and remediation timeline.

lee-qa: quick results from golden set after full switch: latency and hallucination within SLA, sample diffs acceptable. attaching summary (pasted):```\n- 100 samples: 96/100 semantically equivalent, 4 minor phrasing differences\n- avg latency: 0.78s -> within expected\n- error rate: dropped to 0.2%\n```

maya-sre: no further OOMs. memory graphs stable. will keep alarms at lowered threshold to catch regressions.

carlos-oncall: handing off to next shift: maya-sre will stay as primary during stabilization window. I'll update incidents channel and create a short runbook entry.

carlos-oncall: summary for handoff: "Applied tenant-level pin for AuroraCorp -> v1.3.8-quant-safe at 21:17Z after canary. Worker-3 drained and restarted. Monitoring shows restored latencies and reduced hallucination. CS notified. Audit ticket filed."

maya-sre: taking over. I'll post updates at +15m and +45m.

tina-ps: customer acknowledged and thanks the team. they requested timeline for root cause and whether we can keep the pin or plan upgrade. I'll coordinate post-mortem action items with product.

carlos-oncall: action items assigned: alice.platform to run workload replay against v1.4.2 in isolated infra to reproduce KV behavior; eng-runtime to investigate memory regression on quantized path; product to scope whether v1.4.x rollback/patch is required for Dedicated.

incident-bot: Incident 9421 status -> mitigated. Pager re-open if regressions observed. :white_check_mark:

maya-sre: noted. I'll keep the incident channel updated and close once 60m stable window passes.

sam-solutions: thanks everyone — good coordination. I'll draft a short customer-facing note and share with Tina for approval.

carlos-oncall: closing loop. great work.
